meta.name: GS029 Google Review Comments
meta.guideline_note: Every generated review keeps all mandatory fields for its selected UGC category.
meta.customer_note: Customer chooses and submits the review using their own account and device with clear consent.
meta.monthly_rule: Repeated Google Reviews from the same user within the same month count as one review only.
meta.template_note: 350 individually written complete comments. No random opener/suffix combinations. Edit to match the actual experience.
